subject.title: [Bug]: The bundled plugins openshell does not work correctly since version 2026.03.13

question: Should sandbox CLI commands activate the full plugin registry, or should OpenClaw add a narrower sandbox-backend registration path for status, recreate, and explain?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the safest permanent boundary is a maintainer decision because the active fix changes plugin activation for an entire CLI namespace.

options.title: Prefer backend-scoped activation
options.body: Add or request a narrower sandbox-backend registration path so sandbox status can see OpenShell without loading every enabled plugin.

options.title: Accept full sandbox CLI activation
options.body: Approve the linked PR's broader namespace policy and own the availability tradeoff for unrelated plugin activation failures.

options.title: Pause for plugin runtime design
options.body: Keep the issue open and pause the PR until maintainers choose the long-term plugin runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Prefer backend-scoped activation
recommendation.body: Add or request a narrower sandbox-backend registration path so sandbox status can see OpenShell without loading every enabled plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person on the affected OpenShell, sandbox management, and CLI policy files where the activation boundary is now maintained.
